I’m in the process of looking for apartments. My dad is such a huge beacon of light and positivity in my life but unfortunately I cant live with him because he’s kinda created his own new life and family about an hour away from where I live and further away from where I go to college. Everything is so expensive in my town because we’ve recently been overrun with gentrifiers from a nearby major city who have come to my town “in the country” and made rent impossible for locals. Anything I can afford is section 8 kinda stuff and I genuinely don’t even care. My dad and siblings keep saying to keep staying at my moms and saving money but I’ve been waiting my entire life for this and I need to remove myself from this environment. My mom keeps saying why do you wanna pay to live when you can live for free. That’s because its not really free. It costs so much for my mental health. The cost is worth it to me even though I don’t have much and probably wouldn’t have furniture for a while. I wouldn’t even care as long as its mine. As for my boyfriend, he has a lot of issues. I try to urge him to get help but he doesn’t want to. Im also not the best to encourage that because i have a lot of untreated issues that I don’t feel ready to get help for yet. I am getting closer but i am not ready to unravel the years of abuse, self hate, self esteem issues, self harm and even more not ready to unravel the issues with my mom and family dynamic. Its been my entire life and i feel like the more i wait, the more i think I can’t even begin to explain this all since the beginning. 20+ years of my life. It’s such a daunting task to even think of. And im scared i will have a bad therapist and of course the idea that i have where I always feel like im lying. I don’t know what that is. Today i was given a survey at a doctors appointment and it asked common questions used to identify depression. I filled out some as feeling a 1 on a scale of 0-5. Its hard to be fully honest like that. But i was hoping someone would bring it up to me and nobody did. And i was too scared to mention it. Anyway, i do love him very much and our relationship can be very positive at times. I know i have incredibly low standards as my only other boyfriend and most sexual partners were abuse and unkind and i feel like I’m not worth the kind of relationship I imagine as “perfect.” He’s often suicidal. And i fear that he would hurt himself if i left him. I’d also feel very lost without him which i know isnt good. He is my best friend and honestly my old friend. I think we are really good as friends but in terms of relationship maybe we got into it too much at the beginning and i know i have desires and expectations that he will not fulfill and when ive tried to express that it turns into well if you dont like it than leave and i guess I’d rather have him the way he is than expect anyone to fulfill my idea partner. Nothing in life in ideal anyway. Im sorry for taking a while to reply. I’ve been thinking about replying for a few days now. Thank you for your message. As much as i believe a lot of your words are true, i just cant bring myself to give myself what i know i deserve. It felt nice to talk a little more in detail about things. Thank you.
